description:
高山市: GTFS transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by 高山市. Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Takayama, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. Coverage: Takayama, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. The Mobility Database lists 2 GTFS schedule feeds for this provider (Takayama, Gifu Prefecture, Japan). The schedule feeds declare these GTFS features: Attributions, Fares V1, Feed Information, Headsigns, Location Types, Route Colors, Shapes, Transfers. At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. Note in the listing: 収録路線：のらマイカー全路線　中心部（東線・西線・南線・北線・岩滝線）、上宝、清見、荘川、国府、丹生川地域
予約制の路線を除く
GTFS-JP３版対応 It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
